description: Return where each entry's data comes from: the provider's site, docs and evidence pages, the license or terms URL with the license note, and the lastVerified date, plus the Signal Lab page. Pass up to 25 slugs, or the same filters as search_catalog (all entries if none). A URL the catalog does not record is left out.

auth.description: What sign-up is needed, as the catalog records it, for example none or free API key

badge.description: Access type: Free, Open Source, Freemium or Unofficial

category.description: The catalog's category, for example Market Data or Macro

domain.description: Data domain: Financial, Global Macro, Energy, Agriculture & Food, Money Flows, Transport & Shipping, Research & Grey Literature, Weather, News & RSS, OSINT or Cyber Threat

license.description: The catalog's license value, for example Provider terms or MIT

query.description: Words or known alias concepts that must all match catalog text. Aliases match whole terms; other words use substring matching

slugs.description: Entry slugs; when given, filters are ignored

task.description: One task tag, for example macro or market-data

type.description: Kind of entry, for example Dataset or Tool

verified.description: true: only entries counted as Verified resources in llms.txt; false: only the others (Signal Lab originals: recipes and starter kits; and entries marked Needs review)

verified_since.description: Only entries whose lastVerified date is on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: get_source_urls
title: Get original source and terms URLs
